root_cause: Data-residency assumptions were encoded as if Netlify Functions and Netlify Blobs supported per-function/per-store Frankfurt pinning. Provider contract inspection and deploy readback showed that these assumptions were not valid for the used runtime/API.

netlify.interpretation: runtime observation only; not an EU residency guarantee

prevention: Never infer data residency from a provider name, intended target region, UI selection or one runtime sample.
Only claim EU-only when configuration is supported by the provider and runtime/provider readback proves the effective region.
Keep Netlify customer-data paths fail-closed for EU_ONLY while compute/storage residency is not proven.
Keep Supabase customer-data authority in eu-central-1 and explicitly invoke Edge Functions with x-region eu-central-1.
Block confidential AI and connector execution before external processing when the tenant sovereignty policy is not satisfied.
Treat preferred AI provider/region as desired state until the selected provider is ACTIVE and evidence-backed.
Expose UNKNOWN/PARTIAL states in the portal instead of converting them to green.
